decks.summary: Top-deck Norman who commits his revealed top card with Astronomical Atlas and Written in the Stars, finds Livre d'Eibon through Research Librarian, and investigates with Milan and Divination; very consistent.
Two-box Norman from the Revised Core and Edge of the Earth with a Miskatonic study group of Milan, Jeremiah Kirby, Professor Webb and Medical Students, four Sled Dogs, and Forced Learning to dig.
Solo and multiplayer Norman on Mr. "Rook", No Stone Unturned and Split the Angle to control his top card, with Hawk-Eye Folding Camera for clues and Shrivelling for defence.
Early solo Night of the Zealot Norman who cycles his deck with Split the Angle and No Stone Unturned, investigates with Magnifying Glass, and fights with Shrivelling and Anatomical Diagrams.
Simpler two-box Norman who stacks double-icon cards so Written in the Stars, Pocket Telescope and Livre d'Eibon hit his top-card combo more often, with Shrivelling for defence.
A Revised Core and Edge of the Earth starter Norman built to share cards with four sibling starter decks: Old Book of Lore, Medical Texts, Livre d'Eibon, Professor Webb and a few Sled Dogs.
Elusive clue-finder Norman who plays fast cards off the top of his deck and uses Mind's Eye to test intellect for everything, evading with Blinding Light and Bind Monster.
Spanish-language Core and Edge of the Earth Norman built purely to find clues with Milan, Magnifying Glass and Written in the Stars, relying on a partner for enemies.
Written in the Stars Norman who reuses power skills across the extra tests Summoned Hounds give him, investigating at 7 with Magnifying Glass and St. Hubert's Key.
Fighting Seeker Norman who churns his deck to play Mind over Matter and Anatomical Diagrams reliably, fighting with Knives and Shrivelling and investigating with Fingerprint Kit and Milan.
